newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Danu absorbs some FIN1 property loans.
newsitem.headline: Thai Danu absorbs some FIN1 property loans.

text.p: Thai Danu Bank Plc said on Thursday it would absorb less than 30 percent of the outstanding 21 billion baht ($808 million) in property loans extended by Finance One Plc when the two companies merge.

Thai Danu president Pornsanong Tuchinda said his bank would take into account about six billion baht of Finance One's property loans into the strengthened bank and exclude the remaining 15 billion baht that the finance firm lent to the troubled sector.
"Thai Danu does not face any property loan problem while Finance One, like most other finance firms, is over-exposed to the sector," he said.
Pornsanong said the due diligence process of assessing their assets for share swapping purposes would take up to 45 days from a March 14 signing of their initial merger agreement.
The banker said the 21 billion baht property loans were part of Finance One's total outstanding 66 billion baht loans.
The merged company, retaining the Thai Danu name, would not cover 1.5-1.6 billion baht of auto and consumer hire-purchase loans extended by Finance One.
